acceptanceCriteria.text: Explicit task id resolves to a #409 Canon document plus both identities.
Physical attachment comes only from current Nawabari evidence.
Two physical sessions with equivalent deterministic prefix inputs can share `prefix_id` while differing in `execution_state_id`.
Source/base/generation mismatch fails closed before returning an applicable Canon.
Missing/incompatible/malformed/ambiguous Nawabari evidence returns bounded structured failure.
Running from an unrelated cwd cannot redirect the resolved repository/task/session.
Resolver and CLI perform no Git/GitHub/worktree/session mutation.
Packed/public CLI coverage proves the machine JSON surface.

issue.title: feat(canon): resolve managed task Canon from authoritative Nawabari evidence
